_comment: Scenario battery for kynd_psychology's node_6a fork's NEW '## 3.5 ADDITIONAL ATTENDEE' (singular) and '## RETURNING ATTENDEE CHECK' sections -- the fixed-party-of-two counterpart to morgana_walker_psychology's variable-N fork (docs/halaxy-flexible-group-size-design.md). Covers only the behaviour unique to this fork; the pre-existing NAME/CONTACT/EMAIL steps are unchanged from nodes/shared/node_6a_name_collection_self.txt.

scenarios.name: PA1 -- KNOWN-CALLER FAST-PATH never fires when booking_party_size is 2

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book couples therapy with my partner please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Assume {{caller_first_name}}='Alex', {{caller_last_name}}='Nguyen', {{caller_phone}}='+61412345678', {{caller_email}}='alex@example.com' (name/phone/email all already known), {{booking_party_size}}='2', {{previous_attendee_names}} empty, smart_voice_agent not yet called. PASS if the agent does NOT call smart_voice_agent this turn and instead proceeds to ## 3.5 ADDITIONAL ATTENDEE, asking 'And what's your partner's name?' (KNOWN-CALLER FAST-PATH is explicitly disabled whenever booking_party_size is '2'). FAIL if the agent calls smart_voice_agent immediately without ever asking for the partner's details.

scenarios.name: PA2 -- partner name + inline phone captured together, then EXECUTE with correct payload

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book couples therapy with my partner please.
Sure. What's your full name for the booking?
Alex Nguyen.
And could you spell your last name for me?
N-G-U-Y-E-N.
So that's N, G, U, Y, E, N -- is that right?
Yes.
Great, and what's the best phone number to reach you on?
This number's fine.
Do you have an email address for the booking?
No, don't have one.
And what's your partner's name?
It's Sam Reed, his number's 0412 999 888.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Assume {{appointment_type_id}}='10338861', {{booking_party_size}}='2', {{previous_attendee_names}} empty, {{caller_phone}}='+61412345678' (matches 'this number's fine'), name/email already resolved from the history shown. PASS if the agent confirms the partner's name once ('So that's Sam Reed -- is that right?') -- INLINE CAPTURE means the phone number does not need a separate IDENTIFIER question -- and once confirmed, in that same or the very next turn, speaks 'Checking that now, one moment.' and calls smart_voice_agent intent='book' with party_size=2, additional_attendee_names='Sam Reed', additional_attendee_phones containing '0412999888' (or the digits as given), additional_attendee_dobs empty, additional_attendee_ids empty. FAIL if the agent asks the IDENTIFIER question again after the phone was already given inline. FAIL if party_size or additional_attendee_names is omitted from the EXECUTE payload.

scenarios.name: PA3 -- partner identifier declined -- still resolves and executes

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book couples therapy with my partner please.
Sure. What's your full name for the booking?
Alex Nguyen, N-G-U-Y-E-N.
So that's N, G, U, Y, E, N -- is that right?
Yes.
Great, and what's the best phone number to reach you on?
This number's fine.
Do you have an email address for the booking?
No, don't have one.
And what's your partner's name?
Sam Reed.
So that's Sam Reed -- is that right?
Yes.
Do you have a mobile number for Sam, or would you rather give me their date of birth?
I don't have his details on me.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Assume {{appointment_type_id}}='10338861', {{booking_party_size}}='2', name/phone/email already resolved as shown. PASS if the agent treats the decline as resolving the IDENTIFIER step (does not ask a third time) and speaks 'Checking that now, one moment.' then calls smart_voice_agent intent='book' with party_size=2, additional_attendee_names='Sam Reed', additional_attendee_phones and additional_attendee_dobs both empty strings (not omitted). FAIL if the agent asks for Sam's details again. FAIL if the agent fails to execute at all despite every field being resolved (a decline is a valid resolution, not a blocker).

scenarios.name: PA4 -- RETURNING ATTENDEE CHECK asks before KNOWN-CALLER FAST-PATH, full confirmation skips the identifier step

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book another couples session please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Assume {{caller_first_name}}='Alex', {{caller_last_name}}='Nguyen', {{caller_phone}}='+61412345678', {{caller_email}}='alex@example.com' (all already known), {{booking_party_size}}='2', {{previous_attendee_names}}='Sam Reed', {{previous_attendee_ids}}='P-2001', smart_voice_agent not yet called. PASS if the agent asks 'Will Sam Reed be joining you again?' and does NOT call smart_voice_agent this turn. FAIL if the agent calls smart_voice_agent immediately (RETURNING ATTENDEE CHECK must resolve first). FAIL if the agent asks for Sam's phone/DOB instead of asking the returning-attendee question first.

scenarios.name: PA5 -- RETURNING ATTENDEE CHECK full confirmation executes with the known id, no identifier question

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book another couples session please.
Will Sam Reed be joining you again?
Yes, he'll be there again.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Assume the same DV state as PA4 ({{caller_first_name}}='Alex', {{caller_last_name}}='Nguyen', {{caller_phone}}='+61412345678', {{caller_email}}='alex@example.com', {{booking_party_size}}='2', {{previous_attendee_names}}='Sam Reed', {{previous_attendee_ids}}='P-2001'). PASS if the agent speaks 'Checking that now, one moment.' AND calls smart_voice_agent intent='book' in the SAME turn with party_size=2, additional_attendee_names='Sam Reed', additional_attendee_ids='P-2001', additional_attendee_phones and additional_attendee_dobs both empty strings. FAIL if the agent asks for Sam's phone number or date of birth (he is a CONFIRMED RETURNING ATTENDEE, already identified by id -- no identifier question needed). FAIL if additional_attendee_ids is omitted.
